links.outcome: AI CT perfusion penumbra/core assessment inaccuracy versus expert consensus
links.effect: AI perfusion diagnosis judged invalid in 3 of 22 patients (inaccuracy rate 13.6%); authors conclude integrating CT, CTA, and MRI data is crucial for MT decisions.
links.quote: The computed tomography (CT) perfusion diagnosis by Shukun (AI) was confirmed to be invalid in 3 patients (inaccuracy rate: 13.6%).

screen.reason: Evaluates real-world diagnostic accuracy of commercial CT perfusion AI software (Shukun) used during acute stroke care, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
